capabilities.ui: business web app and reviewer renderer

limitations: The registration window opens, the deadline is processed and letters are issued only when Infra applies their events; the App never schedules itself.
One conference, one attendee account and one accepted paper per seed; author registration only, no cancellation or refund.
Letters are structured text, not PDFs; there is no passport number on the letter.
Notices carry a Mail CloudEvent in state; Infra publishes them through Messaging.
Payment labels are opaque; the payment is recorded locally, not posted to a card App.
